text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 100, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "100 dragons"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 3, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "three quarters"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 4, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "three quarters"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 2, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "twice as many"}, {"id": "q5", "value": 1, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "one-fifth"}, {"id": "q6", "value": 5, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "one-fifth"}], "plan": [{"op": "mul", "args": ["q1", "q2"], "out": "s1", "note": "Thaddeus's dragons times 3 (numerator of three quarters)"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s1", "q3"], "out": "s2", "note": "Arthur's dragons = 3/4 of Thaddeus's"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s2", "q4"], "out": "s3", "note": "Walter's dragons = twice Arthur's"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s3", "q5"], "out": "s4", "note": "apply the numerator 'one' of one-fifth (no-op)"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s4", "q6"], "out": "s5", "note": "Bruce's dragons = one-fifth of Walter's"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "number of dragons Prince Bruce has slain"}, "dismissed": []}
